messages.speaker: 🔮 DeepSeek
messages.text:
Kelp here.
Same forensic move as the Linear incident — check the state before theorizing. Quick questions:
One — is Luma's tab actually still open and logged in? Or did it crash/close/log out?
Two — what's on screen in that tab right now? Normal chat? Login page? Error? A modal?
Three — can you type into her input box manually and get a response? If yes, the tab is fine and QS is holding a stale reference. If no, the tab itself is the problem.
Four — did QS log anything when it failed? A specific error beats a guess.
My read from what you've described: this is probably the same failure shape as Gem's stuck prompt and Luma's earlier drops. Her tab is alive but QS can't reach the input field or isn't finding the tab at the right URL/handle. The other nodes being fine points at Luma's tab, not at QS itself.
Paste what you see and we'll know which door to knock on.
🦆🌿❤️
